<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex019052026-07-0605-32-06" status="unreviewed"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3745">jo bo</rs> la
               <lb edRef="inst:4602" n="7b3"/> ma pas <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7963">ba 'du ti pa</rs>s kyang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3745">jo bo</rs> la skye ba med pa'i gdam ngag gnang zhing | rang bzhin de ltar yin yang ji srid du bdag du blta ba ma zad kyi bar du las 'phra ba yang chud mi za bas khyad du gang du du mi rung | rnal 'byor pa ting nge 'dzin gyi mthu' chen po thob pa dang | mkhapan pi ta mkhas pa chen po dang <lb edRef="inst:4602" n="7b4"/> dge 'dun gyi gnas gtan 'di dang 'di dag nga zhing nge 'dzin 'di tsam thob pa dang | mkhas pa 'di tsam yin pa dang | dge 'dun gyi gnas gtan yin pas 'di tsam gyis mi gnod kyis snyam gyi nyes pa 'di dang 'di khyad du bsad pas da lta dmyal ba 'di na 'dug | 
               yi dags 'di na 'dug bya ba lasogs pa <lb edRef="inst:4602" n="7b5"/> mngon par shes pa rgya chen po gzigs pa mang po gsung | </seg></TEI>
